testScopeNote: Contract rows: `cargo test` in `contracts/basic-storage` (isolated Soroban `Env`). Frontend wallet rows: `vitest run` in `frontend/` (module catalog + WalletConnect config; no live wallet). `pocContractId` from `frontend/.env.local` at export time.

categories.title: Unit tests
categories.description: Isolated Soroban `Env` per test; exercises getters/setters and edge values without randomness.

categories.title: Integration tests
categories.description: Separate test crate binary; longer multi-step flows against the same contract client pattern.

categories.title: Deterministic property sweep
categories.description: Structured many-case check (here: 0..100) proving set/get agreement without a random seed.

categories.title: Randomized property (Proptest)
categories.description: Random `u32` inputs each run; shrinks on failure. Demonstrates property-style testing on Soroban.

categories.title: Invariant tests
categories.description: State consistency: last-write wins per slot, plus cross-slot isolation (writes to one key must not clobber another).

categories.title: libFuzzer (cargo-fuzz)
categories.description: Byte-oriented fuzzing of `set`/`get` in a dedicated harness — not part of `cargo test`. Run `make fuzz` for a smoke run.

categories.title: LLVM coverage
categories.description: Line/function instrumentation and HTML/LCOV reports. Shown on this page when `coverage-summary.json` is present.

categories.title: Frontend wallet (Vitest)
categories.description: Stellar Wallets Kit + WalletConnect config: env gating, module catalog (all default wallets), and QR/Reown options. Does not connect real wallets.

externalRuns.name: storage_set_get
externalRuns.cli: cd contracts/basic-storage/fuzz && cargo fuzz run storage_set_get -- -runs=1000
externalRuns.description: Decodes `u32`, `i64`, `u128`, `bool`, and bounded `Bytes` from random input; asserts round-trips on independent slots (same WASM as the repo contract).
externalRuns.note: Not run by this script. Execute locally or in a job with `cargo-fuzz` and LLVM fuzzer deps installed.

externalRuns.name: WalletConnect QR (manual)
externalRuns.cli: Connect wallet → WalletConnect → scan QR with a Stellar mobile wallet
externalRuns.description: Browser-only: Reown modal shows a QR code on `stellar:testnet`. Vitest does not drive real wallet pairing.
externalRuns.note: Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID` in `frontend/.env.local`. Run `make test-frontend` for automated checks.
